user.title: Fuel Prices for GlassHome
user.description: Connects the Fuel Prices UK integration to GlassHome fuel widgets. The Google Maps key is optional: add one with Maps Static API enabled to show the station map. It stays in Home Assistant. Fuel Finder credentials belong in Fuel Prices UK, not here.

abort.already_configured: Fuel Prices for GlassHome is already set up. Use Configure to change the Google key.

init.title: Google map
init.description: Change or clear the Google Maps Static API key used for the station map.
